errors.text: The proposed thermomechanical-processing intervention does not reconstruct the temperature-dependent aging intervention or the critical 600°C embrittlement and 750°C recovery treatments.
The hypothesis does not identify the AlCoCrFeNi2.1 as-cast FCC+B2 microstructure.

The proposed grain-refinement and intermetallic-suppression mechanism misses the controlling L12 ordering, antiphase-boundary energy, planar slip, jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries, and ductile transition zones.
No quantitative temperature or duration window is provided, so the predicted brittle window and ductile recovery cannot be tested.
The required retention of the original strength-ductility combination is neither built into the intervention nor measured in the falsification experiment.
